description: Bus- und Straßenbahnlinien des Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreises is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.en-kreis.de. This dataset contains the approximate travel distances of buses and trams of the Ennepe-Ruhr district. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bus and tram lines of the Ennepe-Ruhr district" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Straßenbahnlinien, Buslinien, Linienfahrplan, Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis, Buslinie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
